messages:
Alice: Heads-up — starting canary for stable v2.4.1 (5% -> 50%). Quick q: if we need an emergency rollback, do we create v2.4.2 as a patch or reuse v2.4.1 with buildmeta? Want clarity for release notes.
Ben: I'd prefer a new patch + buildmeta. Easier for metrics and CI traces. Reusing tags causes cache mismatches.
Carol: Bumping the patch means consumers interpreting this as new code. Rollback patch is technically a new release though — hmm.
Dmitri: Important: customers who pin exact tags won't get the rollback automatically if we publish v2.4.2. For private/dedicated, pinning is common.
Nina: For pinned customers, updating routing is needed regardless. We could also do a buildmeta tag (e.g., v2.4.1+rb20240321) but package managers treat + inconsistently.
Alice: Deploy-bot currently tags via `git tag -a v$VERSION -m "release" && git push origin v$VERSION`. What if deploy-bot made a rollback annotated tag `v2.4.1+rb.1` instead of bumping?
Ben: Git allows + but registries... npm ignores build metadata, Docker tags don't follow semver. Risky.
Carol: Another option: prerelease `v2.4.1-rollback.1` but semver ranges ignore prerelease by default.
Dmitri: Operational vote: don't repush existing tags. Create v2.4.2 as rollback and notify pinned customers; also update routing for pinned ones if they need forced rollback.
Nina: Routing per-customer is heavier but safest for pinning. We should add a short runbook.
Alice: Thoughts? @release-sheriff
deploy-bot: Canary update — v2.4.1 at 50% (10m elapsed). Metrics: OK. No errors >1%.
Ben: Given the pinned-client constraint, I agree with Dmitri for now — new patch v2.4.2 as rollback + pinned-customer notifications. I'll draft release note.
Carol: Action items: Ben file the release note, Dmitri file the pinned-routing play, Nina open policy PR to standardize rollback tags.
Nina: I'll create the PR: RFC for rollback semantics (patch vs tag vs routing) and include examples for `git`/deploy-bot behavior.
Alice: Sounds good. Let's keep the decision for this rollout: bump patch to v2.4.2 (rollback) and coordinate pinned changes. :thumbsup:
Ben: release-note draft: "2.4.2 — emergency rollback to commit abc123; restores service for X customers; see ticket #4567" I'll post when done.
Dmitri: I'll ping CS for any pinned customers that need manual routing.
Nina: Filed rfc: PR #789, will @eng on it.
Alice: Thanks all. We'll proceed.
